title: user authentication and authorization

title: admin panel and management
description: Verify admin dashboard functionalities including user, company, project management, and system settings to ensure comprehensive administrative control.

title: job management system
description: Test job posting with multi-step forms, AI-powered job matching, application process, and workflow tracking to ensure smooth job lifecycle management.

title: project management
description: Validate project creation, tracking, resource allocation, and quality assurance features for clients and technicians.

title: client and company management
description: Test client onboarding, company setup, and relationship management functionalities to ensure proper data handling and user experience.

title: chat and communication system
description: Verify real-time chat, file sharing, audio call capabilities, and message delivery without loss or delay.

title: wallet and payment system

title: audit and security system

title: file management and uploads

title: notification system
description: Verify real-time notification dispatch and receipt across platform users for job updates, messages, payments, and tasks.
